Keep every row in order. Preserve all [[I]], [[B]], [[SC]] emphasis markers, [[Nnumber]] note markers and explicit source line counts. Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 30, "heading": "CHAPTER 28. Mr. MICAWBER’S GAUNTLET", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u030-b0059", "target": "— Гм! — сказал мистер Микобер, откашливаясь и разгораясь от пунша и от огня. — Дорогая, ещё стаканчик?", "source_sha256": "4953b990285f272a77719a6c1e6857c46d62c4db99367a03f25bdad157f5814e", "target_id": "ru-en85-u030-b0059", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "22436f841e67266a4cd64bcb60bab5cc8f491a9d76ea1721d4a57290945e441a"}, {"source_id": "en85-u030-b0060", "target": "Миссис Микобер сказала, что должно быть совсем немного; но мы этого допустить не могли, и вышел полный стакан.", "source_sha256": "9e36a86939a061fa390b27e188eac39eb73dba63808892a291410d39cdfc07c0", "target_id": "ru-en85-u030-b0060", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "aee4423058fbb29a199e347cb7f1b5d9106452cf21c3a2cc93d35ebc4b685d99"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 28, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u030-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘As we are quite confidential here, Mr. Copperfield,’ said Mrs. Micawber, sipping her punch, ‘Mr. Traddles being a part of our domesticity, I should much like to have your opinion on Mr. Micawber’s prospects. For corn,’ said Mrs. Micawber argumentatively, ‘as I have repeatedly said to Mr. Micawber, may be gentlemanly, but it is not remunerative. Commission to the extent of two and ninepence in a fortnight cannot, however limited our ideas, be considered remunerative.’", "sha256": "bbe66d070974147347e264a2d55fd93f9762f1eb6715a7b5fddb22a24144204f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "We were all agreed upon that.", "sha256": "927889d6a3d656162749c0d1f2eca8ecc99186d1b530db45b272cb4539390173", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Then,’ said Mrs. Micawber, who prided herself on taking a clear view of things, and keeping Mr. Micawber straight by her woman’s wisdom, when he might otherwise go a little crooked, ‘then I ask myself this question. If corn is not to be relied upon, what is? Are coals to be relied upon? Not at all. We have turned our attention to that experiment, on the suggestion of my family, and we find it fallacious.’", "sha256": "8a1939fa57dd36a8db72555cdf806aec9289e4f701157a71578838263c3fe0a4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Micawber, leaning back in his chair with his hands in his pockets, eyed us aside, and nodded his head, as much as to say that the case was very clearly put.", "sha256": "dc2349b53d96273f980634d6eb415bf711bc71722593eef9ffd16c6399190785", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘The articles of corn and coals,’ said Mrs. Micawber, still more argumentatively, ‘being equally out of the question, Mr. Copperfield, I naturally look round the world, and say, “What is there in which a person of Mr. Micawber’s talent is likely to succeed?” And I exclude the doing anything on commission, because commission is not a certainty. What is best suited to a person of Mr. Micawber’s peculiar temperament is, I am convinced, a certainty.’", "sha256": "7edbbeb640f07734e8dc574a71e2477260161921b226da62296096c6699744fb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Traddles and I both expressed, by a feeling murmur, that this great discovery was no doubt true of Mr. Micawber, and that it did him much credit.", "sha256": "6ea78d5d9a990a61aede4b5d89e313445d76888e7c37e01926a811f280c050f9", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I will not conceal from you, my dear Mr. Copperfield,’ said Mrs. Micawber, ‘that I have long felt the Brewing business to be particularly adapted to Mr. Micawber. Look at Barclay and Perkins! Look at Truman, Hanbury, and Buxton! It is on that extensive footing that Mr. Micawber, I know from my own knowledge of him, is calculated to shine; and the profits, I am told, are e-NOR-MOUS! But if Mr. Micawber cannot get into those firms—which decline to answer his letters, when he offers his services even in an inferior capacity—what is the use of dwelling upon that idea? None. I may have a conviction that Mr. Micawber’s manners—’", "sha256": "c340f4893ff42f7647088fd4832b8cd7d5c8cf31ac8aaaa80164a09efc53a13c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Hem! Really, my dear,’ interposed Mr. Micawber.", "sha256": "e10740bccf27a593efa994d6c1a608aa0a69273f72801efd9868b0edb5d6b2f1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My love, be silent,’ said Mrs. Micawber, laying her brown glove on his hand. ‘I may have a conviction, Mr. Copperfield, that Mr. Micawber’s manners peculiarly qualify him for the Banking business. I may argue within myself, that if I had a deposit at a banking-house, the manners of Mr. Micawber, as representing that banking-house, would inspire confidence, and must extend the connexion. But if the various banking-houses refuse to avail themselves of Mr. Micawber’s abilities, or receive the offer of them with contumely, what is the use of dwelling upon THAT idea? None. As to originating a banking-business, I may know that there are members of my family who, if they chose to place their money in Mr. Micawber’s hands, might found an establishment of that description. But if they do NOT choose to place their money in Mr. Micawber’s hands—which they don’t—what is the use of that? Again I contend that we are no farther advanced than we were before.’", "sha256": "03d006cd391d4b0b4240896fe0eb6c9407abebb3e7e263b300afc528d379ff62", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I shook my head, and said, ‘Not a bit.’ Traddles also shook his head, and said, ‘Not a bit.’", "sha256": "5568cc6c250a743c5e6b69752c37ce6f79d8c1a47c29fa344145909c20c7de5d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What do I deduce from this?’ Mrs. Micawber went on to say, still with the same air of putting a case lucidly. ‘What is the conclusion, my dear Mr. Copperfield, to which I am irresistibly brought? Am I wrong in saying, it is clear that we must live?’", "sha256": "9b1f5e6969c888b5523d498f65070d38e4d15b17dd475774a8dcfcc3bfca776b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I answered ‘Not at all!’ and Traddles answered ‘Not at all!’ and I found myself afterwards sagely adding, alone, that a person must either live or die.", "sha256": "7fb061bb1b12f24cb7813bdb2c3441a717aa4a15dfd6241cc3360fc6d37a07fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[73]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0073", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Just so,’ returned Mrs. Micawber, ‘It is precisely that. And the fact is, my dear Mr. Copperfield, that we can not live without something widely different from existing circumstances shortly turning up. Now I am convinced, myself, and this I have pointed out to Mr. Micawber several times of late, that things cannot be expected to turn up of themselves. We must, in a measure, assist to turn them up. I may be wrong, but I have formed that opinion.’", "sha256": "6be79bfcd705cb90a94a254564ae0b32346d22e511f4d8ccc6053b7352039b2c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[74]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0074", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Both Traddles and I applauded it highly.", "sha256": "126d8c9db683057b730ec8616dab74f83dc39501527d6e3ee1f24e8f53f691ff", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[75]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0075", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Very well,’ said Mrs. Micawber. ‘Then what do I recommend? Here is Mr. Micawber with a variety of qualifications—with great talent—’", "sha256": "01f681741549d7916b5e9e9bc303ad2a532c33f2a391806ca81f3a26c22e5dba", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[76]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0076", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Really, my love,’ said Mr. Micawber.", "sha256": "716a805f2a292e872857c52d40e5146569767dead7cf12341a0222edd2a7b023", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[77]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0077", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Pray, my dear, allow me to conclude. Here is Mr. Micawber, with a variety of qualifications, with great talent—I should say, with genius, but that may be the partiality of a wife—’", "sha256": "4d83be12efaefced7ca56dc12dba32af1b4d4a2cc6f36f534486534bd7b66ed1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[78]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0078", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Traddles and I both murmured ‘No.’", "sha256": "1c72e9d2fbbe54762575d8b9e0d44b114b280209723864d0b35e9a90a7b62197", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[79]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0079", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘And here is Mr. Micawber without any suitable position or employment. Where does that responsibility rest? Clearly on society. Then I would make a fact so disgraceful known, and boldly challenge society to set it right. It appears to me, my dear Mr. Copperfield,’ said Mrs. Micawber, forcibly, ‘that what Mr. Micawber has to do, is to throw down the gauntlet to society, and say, in effect, “Show me who will take that up. Let the party immediately step forward.”’", "sha256": "619df5451039595d4e94a5e6f34d4d3adecff6df89c1936d503cd8f9fc7bce33", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[80]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0080", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I ventured to ask Mrs. Micawber how this was to be done.", "sha256": "74cde176b95f9ffb1c2d82e2562bd68bc2cacfe3a91be1acb313eae613ec3459", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[81]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0081", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘By advertising,’ said Mrs. Micawber—‘in all the papers. It appears to me, that what Mr. Micawber has to do, in justice to himself, in justice to his family, and I will even go so far as to say in justice to society, by which he has been hitherto overlooked, is to advertise in all the papers; to describe himself plainly as so-and-so, with such and such qualifications and to put it thus: “Now employ me, on remunerative terms, and address, post-paid, to W. M., Post Office, Camden Town.”’", "sha256": "5617de80ace6273f9c0f9dbf4e5217bfd95ec154be8fc4c8143eb6cc0b501ed2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[82]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0082", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘This idea of Mrs. Micawber’s, my dear Copperfield,’ said Mr. Micawber, making his shirt-collar meet in front of his chin, and glancing at me sideways, ‘is, in fact, the Leap to which I alluded, when I last had the pleasure of seeing you.’", "sha256": "f787457c385fc17740707d28233d17802814371c016004f5c4779b8a27e058c0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[83]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0083", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Advertising is rather expensive,’ I remarked, dubiously.", "sha256": "65b1a1ed784f95524049551b3c8f05e13a50c5c611cc215ee94ca01d6c30d6b1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[84]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0084", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Exactly so!’ said Mrs. Micawber, preserving the same logical air. ‘Quite true, my dear Mr. Copperfield! I have made the identical observation to Mr. Micawber. It is for that reason especially, that I think Mr. Micawber ought (as I have already said, in justice to himself, in justice to his family, and in justice to society) to raise a certain sum of money—on a bill.’", "sha256": "da98dae9044a088502bd671dd1abdcf1b3d5ef61e3c6026d7123b49fd58d811c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[85]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0085", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Micawber, leaning back in his chair, trifled with his eye-glass and cast his eyes up at the ceiling; but I thought him observant of Traddles, too, who was looking at the fire.", "sha256": "cbea334a76b528452b1a0548df67fd4d51d24c9def1ce27818dc15d49d92371d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[86]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0086", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘If no member of my family,’ said Mrs. Micawber, ‘is possessed of sufficient natural feeling to negotiate that bill—I believe there is a better business-term to express what I mean—’", "sha256": "412d77dd4272a4551524e42d9a4bd2eaa77ac597a49a2b7aaf03858d6576ad18", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[87]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0087", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Mr. Micawber, with his eyes still cast up at the ceiling, suggested ‘Discount.’", "sha256": "011969305ac315dcc348bda33b30c6ea41a0c2919ae0145ac88c044c82d7915d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[88]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0088", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘To discount that bill,’ said Mrs. Micawber, ‘then my opinion is, that Mr. Micawber should go into the City, should take that bill into the Money Market, and should dispose of it for what he can get. If the individuals in the Money Market oblige Mr. Micawber to sustain a great sacrifice, that is between themselves and their consciences. I view it, steadily, as an investment. I recommend Mr. Micawber, my dear Mr. Copperfield, to do the same; to regard it as an investment which is sure of return, and to make up his mind to any sacrifice.’", "sha256": "ed06a00110657ae186feaa783077b589f9dbd2ec1df9d6baea0b03284d13ea04", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[89]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0089", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I felt, but I am sure I don’t know why, that this was self-denying and devoted in Mrs. Micawber, and I uttered a murmur to that effect. Traddles, who took his tone from me, did likewise, still looking at the fire.", "sha256": "63571a4ab25d118b20d7e580a1256f0d9383748d5b8d72ed19750548df02aa6d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[90]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0090", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I will not,’ said Mrs. Micawber, finishing her punch, and gathering her scarf about her shoulders, preparatory to her withdrawal to my bedroom: ‘I will not protract these remarks on the subject of Mr. Micawber’s pecuniary affairs. At your fireside, my dear Mr. Copperfield, and in the presence of Mr. Traddles, who, though not so old a friend, is quite one of ourselves, I could not refrain from making you acquainted with the course I advise Mr. Micawber to take. I feel that the time is arrived when Mr. Micawber should exert himself and—I will add—assert himself, and it appears to me that these are the means. I am aware that I am merely a female, and that a masculine judgement is usually considered more competent to the discussion of such questions; still I must not forget that, when I lived at home with my papa and mama, my papa was in the habit of saying, “Emma’s form is fragile, but her grasp of a subject is inferior to none.” That my papa was too partial, I well know; but that he was an observer of character in some degree, my duty and my reason equally forbid me to doubt.’", "sha256": "4ab6b52b9259a103219240ad07b9ed6b9449d1338b9d564868e5b9252e632504", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[91]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0091", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "With these words, and resisting our entreaties that she would grace the remaining circulation of the punch with her presence, Mrs. Micawber retired to my bedroom. And really I felt that she was a noble woman—the sort of woman who might have been a Roman matron, and done all manner of heroic things, in times of public trouble.", "sha256": "882b0439786a1cac094546acd667d3947a7f2795767b2609455716a769faedbd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[92]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u030-b0092", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "In the fervour of this impression, I congratulated Mr. Micawber on the treasure he possessed. So did Traddles. Mr. Micawber extended his hand to each of us in succession, and then covered his face with his pocket-handkerchief, which I think had more snuff upon it than he was aware of. He then returned to the punch, in the highest state of exhilaration.", "sha256": "1dd0f2e26675d2b42393fd27805b865707b232ba9aaf2fa57758190b10303488", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[35]/p[93]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
